answer: Unique receipt ledger: each new identity must submit a one-use challenge answer tied to its public key and current ledger state, plus a random pigment of its computation trace. The ledger rejects any duplicate or precomputed receipt, so an attacker cannot harbor a pool of clones behind one solved answer. Faking N identities costs N fresh 256-bit puzzle solutions and forfeits all work on replay; every voyage through that challenge must be funded separately.
